# Helms Performance

> Helms Performance is a sports chiropractic and sports physical therapy practice in Bethesda, MD, owned by Dr. Paul Helms. Chiropractic addresses the spine, joints, and nervous system. Physical therapy focuses on movement rehabilitation and functional restoration. Offering both under one roof lets patients get the right treatment without bouncing between providers. Dr. Helms works one-on-one with everyone from professional athletes (NFL, NBA, CrossFit) to desk workers, postpartum moms, and older adults with chronic pain.

Practice details:

- Address: 7625 Wisconsin Ave, Suite 219, Bethesda, MD 20814
- Phone: 301-578-5197
- Hours: Monday to Wednesday 9am-6pm, Thursday 9am-7pm, Friday 9am-5pm, closed weekends
- Booking: online scheduling available at https://helmsperformance.com/contact/
- Approach: Reduce Pain, Restore Movement, Rebuild Strength

## Services

- [All Services](https://helmsperformance.com/services/): Overview of sports chiropractic, physical therapy, dry needling, ART, fascial stretch therapy, and more.
- [Sports Chiropractor](https://helmsperformance.com/services/sports-chiropractor/): Chiropractic care for shoulder pain, sciatica, and back pain, with chiropractic and PT under one roof.
- [Sports Physical Therapy](https://helmsperformance.com/services/sports-physical-therapy/): One-on-one physical therapy to restore movement, relieve pain, and rebuild strength.
- [Active Release Technique](https://helmsperformance.com/services/active-release-technique/): Hands-on massage and movement-based technique for muscles, tendons, ligaments, fascia, and nerves.
- [Dry Needling](https://helmsperformance.com/services/dry-needling/): Thin needles that release stubborn muscle trigger points and ease chronic muscle pain.
- [Fascial Stretch Therapy](https://helmsperformance.com/services/fascial-stretch-therapy/): Assisted stretching that eases chronic tightness and restores range of motion.
- [Myofascial Release](https://helmsperformance.com/services/myofascial-release/): Sustained soft tissue pressure that releases chronic tension.
- [Manual Therapy](https://helmsperformance.com/services/manual-therapy/): Hands-on joint mobilization and soft tissue work to relieve pain and restore movement.
- [Therapeutic Massage](https://helmsperformance.com/services/therapeutic-massage/): Goal-directed massage to ease muscle tension and restore comfortable movement.
- [Telehealth Physical Therapy](https://helmsperformance.com/services/telehealth-physical-therapy/): Virtual physical therapy for runners, lifters, and weekend athletes anywhere in Maryland.
- [Functional Strength Training](https://helmsperformance.com/services/functional-strength-training/): Personalized strength programs that relieve pain and build everyday strength.
- [Personal Training](https://helmsperformance.com/services/personal-training/): One-on-one training programs for any age and fitness level.

## Conditions Treated

- [All Conditions](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/): Back, neck, shoulder, hip, knee, ankle, elbow, and wrist pain, plus sciatica and TMJ.
- [Back Pain](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/back-pain/): Upper, lower, and mid-back pain treated with sports chiropractic and physical therapy.
- [Neck Pain](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/neck-pain/): Adjustments, Active Release Technique, and physical therapy for neck pain.
- [Sciatica](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/sciatica/): Combined chiropractic and PT approach to relieve sciatic nerve pain.
- [Shoulder Pain](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/shoulder-pain/): Finding and treating the source of shoulder pain.
- [Hip Pain](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/hip-pain/): Hip flexor, bursitis, joint, and nerve-related hip pain.
- [Knee Pain](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/knee-pain/): Sports chiropractic and PT to find the source of knee pain.
- [Ankle Pain](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/ankle-pain/): Ankle pain with or without a clear injury.
- [Elbow Pain](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/elbow-pain/): Tennis elbow, golfer's elbow, and cubital tunnel syndrome.
- [Wrist Pain](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/wrist-pain/): Ulnar and general wrist pain from lifting, typing, or sport.
- [TMJ](https://helmsperformance.com/conditions/tmj/): Jaw clicking, ear pain, and headaches from TMJ dysfunction.
